rule: outlook(d+k) = clim7_mean(d+k) + (cw7_today - clim7_mean(today)) * decay^k, clipped 0-100; clim7_mean = 1991-2020 mean of the district 7-day CWRI for that month-day (no further smoothing; 02-29 uses 02-28)
source: operational assumption (persistence of today's anomaly, 20%/day decay); to be replaced by the paper 2 step-13 fit (1991-2020 fit, 2021-2025 check)
